zones.label: 1. Who Is Responsible for Your Personal Information

compliance.summary: The page uses the former company name in its metadata and includes an unsupported consulting description. It also states company contact, location, vendor, data-retention, and privacy-practice claims that are not established in the company sources.

llm_problems.title: Former company name in metadata
llm_problems.issue: The title and social metadata identify the company as Globy, although the company name is GoGloby and Globy is its former name.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the former company name in the metadata with the current company name.
llm_problems.subject: Company name

locations.quote: Privacy Policy | Globy
Read Globy's privacy policy
Privacy Policy | Globy
Read Globy's privacy policy

llm_problems.title: Unsupported consulting activities
llm_problems.issue: Describing GoGloby's activities as consulting conflicts with its stated identity as a staffing and recruiting agency.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the consulting activity from the description of GoGloby's services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby's activities

locations.quote: staffing, consulting, or talent-placement activities

llm_problems.title: Unlisted operating locations
llm_problems.issue: The page claims GoGloby has business locations in Latin America and Europe, including a Bratislava location, which the sources do not identify.
llm_problems.fix: Verify these locations and remove or correct any location claims that cannot be confirmed.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby operating locations

locations.quote: teams and business locations in Latin America and Europe
Račianska 1575/78 831 02 Bratislava Slovakia

llm_problems.title: Unlisted privacy email
llm_problems.issue: The page gives hr@gogloby.com as a contact email, but the sources list sales@gogloby.com and do not verify the HR address.
llm_problems.fix: Verify the HR email and update or remove it if it is not an approved contact.
llm_problems.subject: Privacy email

locations.quote: Email: hr@gogloby.com
contact hr@gogloby.com
Privacy email: hr@gogloby.com

llm_problems.title: Unverified candidate data collection
llm_problems.issue: The page specifies categories of candidate information GoGloby collects, but the company sources do not establish these data-collection practices.
llm_problems.fix: Verify the described collection practices and remove or correct any unsupported statements.
llm_problems.subject: Candidate data collection
llm_problems.page_value: Candidate identity, career, compensation, and assessment information

locations.quote: we may collect information including: Identity and contact information
such as your expected monthly salary or compensation expectations

llm_problems.title: Unverified sensitive-data policy
llm_problems.issue: The page makes specific claims about what GoGloby's application form does not request and how sensitive information is handled, which the sources do not verify.
llm_problems.fix: Verify these application and sensitive-data practices and revise the statements if they are not confirmed.
llm_problems.subject: Sensitive personal information
llm_problems.page_value: Standard application does not ask for sensitive information

locations.quote: GoGloby’s standard application form does not ask candidates to provide sensitive information

llm_problems.title: Unverified third-party data sources
llm_problems.issue: The page says GoGloby may receive candidate information from referrals, recruiters, clients, and public sources, but these practices are not in the company sources.
llm_problems.fix: Verify the stated sources of candidate information and remove or correct unsupported claims.
llm_problems.subject: Candidate information sources
llm_problems.page_value: Recruiters, referrals, platforms, clients, and public sources

locations.quote: we may receive candidate information from recruiters, employee referrals

llm_problems.title: Unverified retention periods
llm_problems.issue: The page sets 12-month and 24-month retention periods that are not specified in the company sources.
llm_problems.fix: Verify the retention periods and remove or correct any that are not approved.
llm_problems.subject: Candidate data retention
llm_problems.page_value: 12 months for recruitment records; 24 months for talent-pool information

locations.quote: talent-pool information will be retained for up to 24 months

llm_problems.issue: The page names Tally and Google Analytics as services GoGloby uses, but the sources do not confirm either provider.
llm_problems.fix: Verify these provider claims and remove or correct any that are not accurate.
llm_problems.subject: Privacy service providers

llm_problems.title: Unverified international data access
llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Legal and security; Glossary §10
llm_problems.issue: The page says candidate information may be accessed or transferred across Europe and other locations, while the sources do not establish those access or transfer practices.
llm_problems.fix: Verify the stated access and transfer arrangements and remove or correct unsupported claims.

llm_problems.title: Unverified candidate data sale policy
llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Legal and security; Glossary §10
llm_problems.issue: The page states that GoGloby does not sell candidate application information, a specific policy not stated in the company sources.
llm_problems.fix: Verify this policy statement and remove or correct it if it is not confirmed.
llm_problems.subject: Candidate application information

llm_problems.fix: Verify the recruiting automation and decision-making statements and remove or correct unsupported claims.
